name: HP Valves & Fittings India Private Limited
india_angle: The company operates a manufacturing facility in Chennai, India, producing valves and fittings for various industries.
summary: HP Valves & Fittings India Private Limited is a manufacturer of industrial valves and fittings, including instrumentation and high-pressure fittings. While their products are essential for various industrial applications, their direct relevance to semiconductor manufacturing is limited.
